vineyards.title: A Vineyard in Nature’s Heart
vineyards.subtitle: Investment, flavor, and nature united in Hamzalar.

bolge_tanitimi.aciklama: The Hamzalar region, located in Konya’s Bozkır district, is one of Anatolia’s most established agricultural areas. Its high altitude, clean air, natural water sources, and fertile soil provide a perfect environment for grape cultivation.
bolge_tanitimi.tarihce: Viticulture in Hamzalar dates back centuries, developed through knowledge passed down from generation to generation. The region’s grape production is highly important for both local consumption and commercial sales.

iklim_ve_toprak.iklim: Bozkır Hamzalar is influenced by a continental climate. Summers are hot and dry, while winters are cold. This harsh climate ensures the grapes are resilient and flavorful. The temperature difference between day and night enhances the grapes’ aromatic structure and makes the ripening process ideal.
iklim_ve_toprak.toprak: The soil is rich in minerals, calcareous, and provides excellent drainage. Thus, grapevine roots can grow deep to access water and nutrients efficiently. The soils of Hamzalar have a suitable pH level for viticulture and are rich in organic matter, giving our grapes their unique flavor profile.

uzum_turleri.ozellikler: Sweet, intensely aromatic, and thin-skinned. Suitable for table consumption and drying.
Slightly sweet and aromatic. When dried, it has a long shelf life.
With its acidic structure, it is suitable for winemaking and is highly durable.
Suitable for white wine production, this variety grows at high altitudes.
Traditional grape varieties unique to the region.

bagcilik_yontemleri.aciklama: We prepare the soil to provide essential nutrients for vine growth. Using natural fertilizers and organic materials, we improve soil structure, increase water retention capacity, and support biodiversity. This method preserves soil health and enhances long-term productivity.

We apply traditional pruning techniques to ensure healthy vine growth and high-quality grape production. Pruning improves productivity, enhances air circulation, and ensures equal sunlight distribution to each vine. It also helps maintain balance throughout the annual growth cycle.

We use the region’s natural water sources to meet the vines’ water needs naturally. The increasingly common drip irrigation system delivers water directly to the roots, ensuring efficient water use. This method conserves water while promoting healthy vineyard development.

By minimizing the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, we practice biological pest control in our vineyards. Using natural predators (such as beneficial insects) and organic solutions, we control pest populations. This approach encourages environmentally friendly and healthy grape production.

Temperature and humidity play a vital role in vine development. Therefore, we use natural methods to control the microclimate in our vineyards. We protect the vines using special coverings and windbreaks to mitigate adverse weather conditions.

hasat_ve_isleme.desc: Grapes are carefully handpicked based on their ripeness levels. Each grape is carefully selected and quality-checked during harvesting. This process preserves the freshness and flavor of the grapes for optimal processing.

Grapes intended for drying are traditionally sun-dried. Grapes are dried naturally in hygienic conditions with sufficient airflow. This process preserves the sugars and nutritional values of the grapes, ensuring healthy drying.

The most suitable grapes for winemaking are carefully selected and prepared for fermentation. The fermentation process facilitates the chemical transformation necessary to produce wine. This stage enhances the flavors and aromas of the grapes, creating the ideal environment for quality wine production.

After drying and processing, grapes are stored under appropriate conditions to maintain freshness for a long time. Humidity and temperature are controlled during storage, ensuring the grapes are preserved without spoilage.

ekonomik_etki.desc: Local markets are a significant sales channel for Hamzalar grapes. Dried grapes, in particular, are in high demand and contribute significantly to the local economy. Producers meet the demand for quality and organic products by offering fresh and natural products directly to consumers. These markets encourage farmers to adopt sustainable agricultural practices while supporting healthy eating habits in the local community.

Hamzalar grapes are offered to international markets. Their high quality makes them popular in European and Middle Eastern markets. Exporting opens global opportunities for local producers and supports regional economic growth. With the increasing global demand for healthy and organic products, Hamzalar grapes have secured a strong position in international markets, increasing producers’ incomes and contributing to local employment.

Vineyard tours and traditional winemaking have significant tourism potential. Tourists explore the natural beauty of Hamzalar while learning about the historical and cultural importance of the vineyards. The grape cultivation process and traditional drying methods are showcased to visitors. Additionally, winemaking is made even more engaging through events organized by local wine producers.
